meta.name: ultimate-browsing
meta.description: Escalation skill for blocked or hard-to-reach web access — load it when a normal browse/fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare, JS-only render, login-gated, or a platform a generic fetcher cannot read). Tiered router: TIER 1 insane-search (headless extraction + WAF bypass via curl_cffi TLS impersonation, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, public APIs, Playwright real-Chrome fallback); TIER 1.5 agent-reach (platform-native readers for Chinese and social platforms: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, V2EX, WeChat, plus Twitter/Reddit/LinkedIn/GitHub); TIER 2 Chrome stealth (CloakBrowser stealth Chromium + agent-browser CDP for clicks, forms, screenshots, video, cookie login). Triggers: blocked site, bypass bot detection, cloudflare/WAF bypass, scrape, stealth browser, import cookies, fill form, screenshot, play youtube, xiaohongshu, douyin, weibo, bilibili, v2ex, wechat article, podcast transcript. NOT for simple searches (use web-search) or plain fetches (use webfetch).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 突破网页访问限制,完成读取、截图、填表和抓取任务。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常遇到网页打不开、被验证码或登录拦住,或需要抓取反爬页面的内容。
copy.tagline_en: Reach blocked or gated pages to read, screenshot, and scrape them.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face blocked pages or need to extract content protected by anti-bot or login walls.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 遇到普通方式打不开的网页时,会按三层顺序处理:先在后台抓取并尝试绕过拦截;不行再调用小红书、微博等平台的专用读取器;还不行就启动隐身浏览器,执行点击、填表、截图等操作,最终把文字、数据或截图给你。
howto.when: 普通抓取被拦(如 WAF、403、Cloudflare 等)或目标平台通用抓取器读不了时触发,如小红书、抖音等;也用于绕过机器人检测、填表、截图等请求。简单搜索不用它。

say.text: 这个网址被 Cloudflare 拦了,帮我提取正文
say.note: 会先尝试绕过拦截,不行再升到隐身浏览器

say.text: 用隐身浏览器打开微博,登录后截图首页
say.note: 会启动隐身 Chromium 并按步骤操作

say.text: 抓取这条抖音视频的标题和评论
say.note: 走平台专用读取器,无需浏览器

howto.what_en: Claude uses three tiers when a page is blocked or unreadable: background extraction and bypass; then platform-native readers (Xiaohongshu, Weibo); then a stealth browser to click, fill, or screenshot, returning the text, data, or image.
howto.when_en: Used when fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare) or the site can't be read by generic fetchers (Xiaohongshu, Douyin); also for bot bypass, forms, screenshots. Not for simple searches.

say_en.text: This URL is blocked by Cloudflare, please extract the article.
say_en.note: Tries best-effort bypass first, then may use a stealth browser.

say_en.text: Open Weibo in the stealth browser, log in, and screenshot the feed.
say_en.note: Launches CloakBrowser and performs the steps.

say_en.text: Fetch the title and comments of this Douyin video.
